Callback and payload field meanings.
Entry sequencing and accessor definitions.

reason: Canonical callback writes integer 1 without a branch; table and struct identify state entry and dispatcher forwards the same static payload to scene entry. This is an integer scene-state initialization, not directly a hardware enable.

Normal exit order, reset exception, exit accessor.
Pending fields, mode-loop consumption and boot-time selection.
Choice processing and exported integer result.

reason: Callback discards scene result and always requests deferred GM_BOOT when invoked. Dispatcher skips exit callbacks during reset; unconditional describes this callback, not every dispatcher path. Source independently verifies startup routing and scene result export without relying on historical wiki evidence.
